name: Atom Corp
summary: Operating in Japan, Atom Livin Tech Co., Ltd. specializes in the development and marketing of interior housing hardware under its ATOM brand. Its extensive product range encompasses items such as locks and hinges for both hinged and sliding doors, fittings for movable partitions and folding doors, indoor aluminum components, and handles. The company also supplies storage and organizational hardware, including slide rails and wire baskets, alongside various furniture fittings, clothesline systems, and a diverse collection of metal goods, notably brass and antique pieces. Atom Livin Tech's clientele comprises furniture manufacturers, architectural hardware retailers, residential construction firms, and those involved in housing equipment applications. The company, established in 1903, is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
